svg.title: Simulated drive from above: true path and three estimates
svg.desc: Top-down view of a simulated run in ArduPilot SITL: the robot drives 5.8 meters forward and back, then spins in place, navigating on optical flow alone. With the sensor's mounting missing from the config, the estimate (orange) reads the drive as sideways motion and ends up 11.5 meters off. With the mounting fixed (yellow) it follows the true path (dashed) but runs 1.2 meters long; with the flow gain tuned (blue), it stays within 0.5 meters.
